options.content: Understand how any performance measurement (LCP, PageLoad, Backend Time, INP, etc) varies across multiple dimensions (Page Group, Device Type, Country, Browser, URL etc)

panels.title: Timers Over Time (use 'GroupBy filter to pick grouping)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT ${groupBy}
  FROM ${mpulse}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
   AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}) , ${pageDomainName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageGroupName in (${pageGroupName:sqlstring}),${pageGroupName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(deviceTypeName in (${deviceTypeName:sqlstring}),${deviceTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(isp in (${isp:sqlstring}),${isp} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(countryCode in (${countryCode:sqlstring}),${countryCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(regionCode in (${regionCode:sqlstring}),${regionCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(geoCity in (${geoCity:sqlstring}),${geoCity} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(paramsU in (${paramsU:sqlstring}),${paramsU} )
  and if (empty('${paramsULike}'),true, paramsU like '${paramsULike}')
    ${omniFilter}
  GROUP BY ${groupBy}
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT ${topN}
)

SELECT ${groupBy}, 
       COUNT(*) AS "-",
       $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time
FROM ${mpulse}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}) , ${pageDomainName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageGroupName in (${pageGroupName:sqlstring}),${pageGroupName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(deviceTypeName in (${deviceTypeName:sqlstring}),${deviceTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(isp in (${isp:sqlstring}),${isp} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(countryCode in (${countryCode:sqlstring}),${countryCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(regionCode in (${regionCode:sqlstring}),${regionCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(geoCity in (${geoCity:sqlstring}),${geoCity} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(paramsU in (${paramsU:sqlstring}),${paramsU} )
  and if (empty('${paramsULike}'),true, paramsU like '${paramsULike}')
  ${omniFilter}
GROUP BY time, ${groupBy}
ORDER BY time ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Page Views per ...; du=${__user.login}'
select ${groupBy} , count(*) as count, $__timeInterval(timestamp) as time from ${mpulse} where $__timeFilter(timestamp) group by time , ${groupBy} order by count desc limit ${topN}

SELECT 
  coalesce(pageDomainName,'(None)') as item, 
  count(*) as count,
  ${aggregation}(${timer}) as metric
FROM ${mpulse}
where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
 AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}) , ${pageDomainName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageGroupName in (${pageGroupName:sqlstring}),${pageGroupName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(deviceTypeName in (${deviceTypeName:sqlstring}),${deviceTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(isp in (${isp:sqlstring}),${isp} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(countryCode in (${countryCode:sqlstring}),${countryCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(regionCode in (${regionCode:sqlstring}),${regionCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(geoCity in (${geoCity:sqlstring}),${geoCity} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(paramsU in (${paramsU:sqlstring}),${paramsU} )
  and if (empty('${paramsULike}'),true, paramsU like '${paramsULike}')
${omniFilter}
group  by item
order by count desc 
limit ${maxTreemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=...by Hostname(...); du=${__user.login}'
